articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring significantly improved latency and a unified architecture that natively reasons across text, code, video streams, and 3D spatial data without separate encoder modules. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-bench and near-human performance on novel PhD-level science questions, raising the bar for agentic coding and research workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Long-Context Retrieval at 5M Tokens
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2 with a verified 5-million-token context window that maintains near-perfect recall on needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks at scale. The model uses a new sparse ring-attention mechanism that reduces memory overhead quadratically, making enterprise-scale document analysis and full-codebase reasoning practical for production deployments.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Shifts at Fremont Factory
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots have started performing supervised logistics and parts-sorting tasks on the Fremont assembly line alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded dexterous hands with 24 degrees of freedom and an onboard vision-language model for interpreting verbal instructions, though they still require a human safety operator within line of sight.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Autonomous Warehouse Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched its commercial Atlas platform powered by an end-to-end learned locomotion and manipulation policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned in real warehouses. The system demonstrated fully autonomous pallet building, irregular package handling, and dynamic obstacle avoidance across a 100,000-square-foot Hyundai logistics facility in Georgia, marking a major milestone in general-purpose humanoid deployment.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers 2.0 to Defend Against Jailbreaks at the Architecture Level
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, an inference-time safety layer embedded directly into the transformer attention mechanism rather than applied as a post-hoc filter. In red-team evaluations, the system reduced successful jailbreak rates to under 0.3% while adding less than 5ms of latency, representing a significant advance in aligning deployed language models against adversarial inputs.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet process has entered high-volume manufacturing at Fab 20 in Tainan, roughly one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% power reduction and 15% performance uplift over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators from NVIDIA and AMD shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink de novo clearance for its N2 implant featuring 4,096 electrode channels — a 4x increase over the first-generation device — along with wireless data transfer rates sufficient for real-time speech decoding. Two participants in the expanded clinical trial have demonstrated cursor control and text generation at speeds exceeding 90 words per minute, approaching natural typing rates.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Three European Assembly Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a major expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots to three additional European manufacturing facilities after a successful 12-month pilot in Spartanburg. The robots handle flexible sub-assembly tasks using a foundation world model that allows them to generalize across new part geometries with minimal re-training, reducing integration time from weeks to hours.
